title: KAITO — Wanting To Give A Push〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. We did practice very hard for it, and now we get to perform it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All the plushies have gathered to watch, so let's make sure we all have a fun time☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It sounds like they have another wonderful show in store for us today...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? What are you all doing here?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The fragment you touched allowed you to see the moment when Tsukasa's feelings produced his SEKAI, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We came to ask if you could tell us more about that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It was born so much earlier than the others, so we wanted to hear about what it was like.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which is why you're all here now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I don't mind, but I'm not sure where to begin in terms of that SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So it came to be after Tsukasa started doing all those shows for his sister, Saki!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: He started coming up with more and more shows to do for her after seeing the way she smiled when they saw their first one.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That desire to make her smile just kept growing bigger and bigger.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She must mean the world to him.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But that SEKAI's Miku and KAITO kept running into stumbling blocks, huh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No matter how hard they tried, they couldn't get him to notice them, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They went over to see him so many times.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But they could never seem to catch him at the right time. I mean, Tsukasa just seemed to be constantly on the move...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Catching people at the right time is always really hard. They're bound to be startled when we suddenly pop out of their phones...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And just when it looks like they're listening, they'll write it off and say it must be part of an advertisement.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That SEKAI's Miku and I patiently watched over him for such a long time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They must have been so worried when he began working towards a new goal and thinking in new ways, even if his core feelings remained unchanged.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, but they kept waiting patiently for the opportune moment to speak with him.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Exactly. Which is why that SEKAI's Miku was so happy when she finally managed to get Tsukasa to notice her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <An exciting show is about to begin♪ Are you ready?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's a Hatsune Miku hologram.
I didn't know she was this park's mascot character.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We made eye contact! I saw him! He saw me! This time, I absolutely know I got his attention!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe☆
We gotta get ready to welcome him fast♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The day we've been waiting for has finally arrived.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: After all, they'd been watching over him ever since that SEKAI was born!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But them reaching the starting line didn't mean their struggles were over...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The stronger your feelings or convictions are, the more difficult it becomes to get back on the right path after losing sight of your true goal.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But that SEKAI's Miku and I were able to guide him back towards his true feelings.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Meeting Emu and the others was also big since they carried very similar feelings, but...)
